rationale: The original thesis remains completely intact, as TU continues to consolidate tightly near the top of its daily range (93.1%) on strong relative volume (3.87x) despite broad market weakness. With 68 minutes remaining in the session and minimal adverse excursion, maintaining the position gives the consolidation room to resolve above the $10.74 session high.
